name: Grove
tagline: Never lose context in your AI coding sessions
description: Grove is a self-hosted memory server that gives AI coding tools long-term memory. It combines semantic vector search with knowledge graphs to let AI assistants remember everything about your projects, tasks, and preferences across sessions.
features: MCP-compatible - works with OpenCode, Cursor, and any MCP client
Semantic search powered by Qdrant vector database
Entity and relation knowledge graphs for structured information
Importance-based memory management - key facts stay accessible
Reranking support for better search relevance
Fast local ONNX embeddings - no external API dependencies
